notes.title: Update v0.5 Multiplayer Playtest Build Live NOW!!!
notes.notes:
The long-awaited multiplayer update is finally here!!! It's been a lot of work getting this out, and we've had our own internal struggles, but we're very proud of what we've done!

There's still some bugs that we have to fix, but once we have all (or at least most) of them fixed then we'll be officially pushing out the update onto live servers! In the meantime, please report any and all bugs to us! We rewrote a LOT of code for this, and of course had to keep it up-to-date with the newer updates, so it's very possible that literally anything could be broken, even in singleplayer! We hope you all enjoy trying out the playtest :D

notes.title: v0.4.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Just a quick hotfix for some issues that were introduced in the last update! Here are the changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where planets weren't able to stop their continuous send orders in multiplayer
[*] Fixed a minor bug where 1 ship would get subtracted from player planets at the start of every game (inconsequential but very annoying)
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.4.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Before I get to the patch notes, I just wanted to say thank you to everyone for the massive amount of support! I expected almost no one to play the game, but so far over 650 people have played and I've received a huge amount of positive support and feedback! So, here's an update that addresses some of the main issues that everyone has been facing so far:

[list]
[*] Added 2 new servers to play on!!!
[*] Optimized ships a LOT, it should be very difficult to crash the game or get less than 30 fps now, let me know if you’re still having issues after this update! Benchmark tests showed an increase from ~5 to ~40 fps when repeatedly sending ships from every planet on a max size galaxy. Here are some of the optimization changes you’ll notice in the gameplay:
[*] Repeatedly sending ships from planets now waits until there are at least 3 ships before they are sent out, I know this is a bit annoying but the performance payoff is really big!
[*] Ships will now only send as a single ship from each planet instead of spawning in groups of 1, 5, 25, etc.

[*] Hopefully fixed the bug where players would disconnect for seemingly no reason, this may cause issues if a player loses connection mid-game so be sure to report any bugs regarding this to me! It will also cause servers to never restart if someone loses connection, so servers will now restart after 30 minutes automatically if it detects that someone has lost connection (this will obviously still cause servers to close prematurely sometimes but a 30-minute delay is much better than instantly!)
[*] Every planet now has 3 small numbers to the right of it to display their levels so that you don’t need to select a planet to see what its levels are
[*] Players and AI will now try to spawn at least 3-4 planets away from other players and AI when possible
[*] Probably fixed the bug where negative numbers would sometimes show on planets
[*] A few other minor bug fixes and QoL improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.4.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The final patch before the game releases on January 14th has arrived! Be sure to wishlist the actual game if you haven't already so that you're notified whenever it releases!

[list]
[*] Added a brand new mechanic - Trading! It will be very buggy (and may have some exploits?) however you can now trade energy and ships with others! For now you can only trade with other players, not AI
[*] There are now lists of every player that is in your lobby/game
[*] Added a text chat in-game
[*] Added 15 new achievements!
[*] Implemented some new/missing assets
[*] Fixed a few small bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Updated v0.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The first patch for Relentless Expanse is live! Nothing too crazy for this one, but hopefully you all enjoy the changes!

[list]
[*] Multiplayer SHOULD be less laggy and more optimized than before, let me know if there’s still issues and I’ll try to optimize it more
[*] Adjusted ship AI so that pathfinding is more predictable, basically ships will now no longer attempt to avoid enemy or neutral planets
[*] Fixed a bug where players could lose if they still had ships but controlled no planets for a brief moment
[*] All of the extra upgrade info for planets is now hidden by default, and holding down “CTRL” on your keyboard will now display that information instead
[*] Updated the “Help” menu when you press Escape so that it gives much more useful information
[*] The loading screen is now some art for Relentless Expanse, and the icon in the taskbar is now the Relentless Expanse icon instead of godot
[*] Various minor UI improvements and replaced many placeholder assets in the main menu and in-game menus
[*] Implemented some new SFX for players winning or losing, defensive platforms being deployed and firing, and a few other things
[*] Added the first steam achievement as a test, more to come soon!
[/list]
